title: Revenge of the Nerds
tagline: Time for the odd to get even.
about: Bullied freshmen at Adams College start their own fraternity and take on the jocks of Alpha Beta at the Homecoming carnival.
cue: Bring out the cream pies when Takashi starts selling them for charity.
faces: PIES FOR CHARITY IN EVERY AISLE. CATCH ONE IF YOU CAN.
The Tri-Lambs' liquid heat payback. Fiery hot wings, cooling ranch, celery.
The Alpha Betas let pigs into the party. Slow pulled pork, slaw, soft rolls.
The Tri-Lambs finally take the nerds in. Spiced lamb, tzatziki, tomato, onion, warm pita.
Freshman year at Adams College, Tucson.
Eat a pie for charity, says Takashi. Biscuit crust, banana custard, whipped cream.
Judy's Omega Mus save the party. Pineapple, lime and dry ginger, lots of ice.

    SnacksLiquid heat chicken wingsThe Tri-Lambs' liquid heat payback. Fiery hot wings, cooling ranch, celery.How to make it1.2kg chicken wings, split1 tbsp baking powder100ml hot sauce1 tsp cayenne pepper50g butter1 tbsp honey150ml ranch dressing4 celery sticks, cut in batonsDry the wings well and toss with the baking powder and salt.Bake on a rack at 220°C, turning once, until crisp.Melt the butter with the hot sauce, cayenne and honey.Toss the wings in the sauce and serve with ranch and celery.Party crasher pulled pork slidersThe Alpha Betas let pigs into the party. Slow pulled pork, slaw, soft rolls.How to make it1.5kg pork shoulder, boneless2 tbsp brown sugar2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder250ml smoky barbecue sauce2 tbsp apple cider vinegar12 slider buns1/4 white cabbage, finely shredded3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaiseRub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt.Put it in a lidded pot with a cup of water and cook at 150°C until it falls apart.Shred the pork and stir through the barbecue sauce and half the vinegar.Toss the cabbage with mayo and the remaining vinegar.Pile the pork and slaw into the buns.A spare pie for OgreThanks! Get your own.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Hot StandLambda Lambda Lambda lamb gyrosThe Tri-Lambs finally take the nerds in. Spiced lamb, tzatziki, tomato, onion, warm pita.How to make it800g lamb leg steaks, thinly sliced3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp dried oregano1 tsp smoked paprika1 lemon3 tbsp olive oil250g Greek yoghurt1 Lebanese cucumber, grated and squeezed8 pita breads2 tomatoes, sliced1 red onion, thinly sliced300g frozen chipsToss the lamb with two thirds of the garlic, the oregano, paprika, lemon juice, oil and salt.Mix the yoghurt with the cucumber, the remaining garlic and salt.Bake the chips until crisp.Sear the lamb in batches in a very hot pan until charred at the edges.Warm the pitas and wrap with lamb, tzatziki, tomato, onion and a few chips.Sonoran hot dogsFreshman year at Adams College, Tucson. Bacon-wrapped franks, beans, salsa, jalapeno.How to make it8 beef frankfurts8 rashers of streaky bacon8 soft split-top bread rolls400g tin pinto beans, drained2 tomatoes, diced1/2 white onion, diced1/4 cup pickled jalapenos4 tbsp yellow mustard4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaiseWrap each frankfurt tightly in a rasher of bacon.Cook in a hot pan, turning, until the bacon is crisp all over.Warm the beans and the rolls.Fill the rolls with the franks, then beans, tomato, onion, jalapenos, mustard and a stripe of mayo.SweetsTri-Lamb charity banana cream piesEat a pie for charity, says Takashi. Biscuit crust, banana custard, whipped cream.How to make it250g plain sweet biscuits, crushed100g butter, melted500ml milk4 egg yolks100g caster sugar40g cornflour1 tsp vanilla extract3 bananas, sliced300ml thickened creamMix the biscuit crumbs with the butter and press into 4 small pie tins, then chill.Whisk the yolks, sugar and cornflour, pour on the hot milk, then stir over heat until thick and add the vanilla.Cool the custard with plastic wrap on the surface.Layer banana and custard in the crusts.Whip the cream and pile it high on top.Cold DrinksOmega Mu party punchJudy's Omega Mus save the party. Pineapple, lime and dry ginger, lots of ice.How to make it1 L pineapple juice3 limes1.3 L dry ginger mixer1 orange, sliced3 cups ice cubesStir the pineapple juice and lime juice in a punch bowl.Add the orange slices and ice.Top with the dry ginger just before serving.Keg beer in a plastic cupPoured at the Alpha Beta end of the field.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
